name: Lightweight Structures & Composite Design
summary: Designing stiff, strong structures at minimum mass with thin-walled sections, sandwich panels, composite laminates, lattices and structural optimisation.

topics.name: Lightweighting strategy: specific stiffness/strength and structural efficiency
Thin-walled open and closed sections: bending, torsion and shear flow
Plate and shell buckling; stiffened panels and crippling
Sandwich structures: face/core design and failure modes
Composite lamina mechanics: micromechanics and orthotropic properties
Classical laminate theory (ABD matrix) and laminate stacking design
Composite failure criteria (Tsai-Wu, Hashin) and damage
Composite manufacturing routes (layup, RTM, filament winding, automated fibre placement) and design implications
Joining lightweight structures: bonded and bolted composite joints
Lattice and cellular structures for additive manufacturing
Frames, shells and protective panels for wearable and mobile machines
